findings.title: Knowing the collection is not the same as searching within it
findings.observed: Some account holders knew the event, album or cohort but described global results or an album that did not jump to the intended photo.
findings.qualification: S23 reports an existing way to navigate from a known image to its day. Do not imply that no contextual navigation feature exists.
findings.question: Ask someone to find an item in a known album or trip. Compare their first query, search scope, result inspection and next action.
findings.metric: Verified retrieval within the intended collection; steps and time to target.

findings.title: Exact words or filenames are not always treated as exact clues
findings.observed: Cases describe queries for screenshot text or a filename that returned conceptually related or date-related results rather than the expected literal match.
findings.qualification: S04 and S35 describe successful quoted-term workarounds; test whether the capability is available and understood before inventing it.
findings.question: Give an existing screenshot containing a known literal phrase. Observe search wording, returned matches and whether the user discovers exact-text behavior.
findings.metric: Correct screenshot retrieval and number of reformulations.

findings.title: A near match can still leave the intended memory out of reach
findings.observed: Accounts describe locating a reference image or partial event set but needing another action to reach surrounding images.
findings.qualification: S23 reports a path that resolved navigation, so this may be a discoverability/flow problem rather than a missing capability.
findings.question: After a user finds a photo from the right day, observe how they navigate to a different image from the same event.
findings.metric: Time from first relevant candidate to verified target; abandoned near misses.

findings.title: Missing results need availability diagnosis before product blame
findings.observed: Some reports describe entire periods or videos absent; the record alone cannot separate forgotten context from backup/account/indexing state.
findings.qualification: S26 found a known set through date search; S58 reported nothing was ultimately lost. These are not confirmed vague-memory failures.
findings.question: First establish that the intended asset exists in the selected account and collection, then reproduce any retrieval mismatch.
findings.metric: Share of attempted tasks with independently confirmed asset presence before retrieval diagnosis.
